summary: As PA Treasurer, Garrity directed $45 million in state funds into Israel Bonds between October 2023 and June 2025, overriding internal Treasury concerns and publicly defending the purchases as showing 'support' for Israel. She thanked the Israel Heritage Foundation on X for the relationship. In an October 2026 gubernatorial debate, she marked the Oct 7 anniversary by naming 1,200 killed, including 49 Americans, framing the conflict solely around the Hamas attack without acknowledging Palestinian civilian casualties or Israeli military conduct.
